scope: Independent static review of final postprocessing source and an existing synthetic schema receipt; not an audit of actual 480 native results.
reviewer: standalone_data agent, separate from analyzer author
conclusion: No remaining blocking issue found in the reviewed MSE selection, planned denominators, failure accounting, timing components, or actual-source provenance logic. Actual numerical results require the complete terminal-run audit.

checks.claim: Final selection is normalized validation MSE; MAE does not enter the primary selector.
checks.detail: Replays each frozen candidate from P,Q,Y and coefficients; checks saved physical and normalized validation MSE. Eligible candidates are within validation_tie of the minimum MSE/reference, then ranked by internal support count, MSE/reference, and index. Both selected and selected_mse_view must reproduce that result.
checks.boundary: selected_mae_view is used only for a diagnostic difference flag; its secondary MAE ranking is not independently re-audited here. The independent primary MSE check does not rely on that flag.

checks.claim: All 48 planned inputs per method remain in exact-recovery and status denominators.
checks.detail: The full four-case/four-shared-seed/three-noise grid and ten methods are required. Each planned job/method creates a row, including failed, interrupted, budget_exceeded, and invalid outcomes. Exact recovery is equality of proper internal support families; exact_rate_planned divides verified exact recoveries by all planned rows.
checks.boundary: F1_verified_mean is the macro mean over verified models only, not an all-48 mean when failures exist; report verified/48 and all status counts alongside it. Pair and factorial effects use their disclosed eligible paired counts.

checks.claim: Failed and unsuccessful method costs are retained when valid; missing components remain unknown.
checks.detail: All wrapper statuses receive finite/nonnegative component checks and, whenever all components exist, total=fresh+common reconciliation. Common charges are checked against shared worker time when available. Bad timing becomes invalid and is excluded from numeric subtotals while original reported_* values survive. Missing total, fresh, common-charge, physical-common-worker, and prepare components have separate unknown counts.
checks.boundary: Recorded subtotals sum known values; an unknown component is not evidence of zero runtime. Logical method totals charge one common preprocessing per method; physical effort charges that shared work once per input. These are process wall-time sums, not CPU time. Calendar time is read from the manager completion record.

checks.claim: Common preprocessing and method results are tied to frozen inputs and actual source receipts.
checks.detail: Validates frozen catalog/runtime hashes and common protocol/train-input/source receipts. Model-bearing records additionally validate common-record SHA, train/validation hashes, before/after native sources, and forbidden-information flags. The actual analyzer is archived by its own SHA; analyzer_pre_run_frozen explicitly distinguishes it from the native frozen snapshot.
checks.boundary: Failed records that never produced a model can lack native loaded-source receipts; they remain unsuccessful outcomes, not verified model evidence. Postprocessing source changes do not alter the recorded native source or grant a new solver budget.

checks.claim: Evaluation waits for every planned method to be terminal, and certificate scopes remain explicit.
checks.detail: Pending runs return or raise before observation decoding or physical-truth access. Model replay uses training and validation; test/truth decoding starts only after all planned runs are terminal and selection has been replayed. Empty native ledgers yield all_native_gap_met=null with native_gap_evidence_available=false.
checks.boundary: verification.passed means no detected audit inconsistency, not that every run succeeded. Report all_models_verified, verified/48, and failure counts. Native gaps cover available subproblem ledgers only; they do not certify the full tree search.

checks.claim: Declared budget and uncertainty descriptions match inspected source defaults.
checks.detail: Source defaults are total 14400 s per method, native MIQP cap 3600 s, fixed-family QP soft cap 300 s, output reserve 600 s. E-on reserves half of available structural time for its final solve; E-off can spend that structural allowance on W/T. SciPy QP time is checked after fitting and can overrun its soft cap; native MIQP uses TimeLimit. Resampling uses four shared seed clusters and is labelled descriptive sensitivity.
checks.boundary: This is a source-default review, not a new verification of the live protocol or hard process interruption guarantee. Factorial effects include the declared E-on/E-off allocation difference.

reported_gaps_addressed_in_final_source: All-status wrapper timing and shared-common reconciliation, including failed/interrupted outcomes.
Missing component timings disclosed independently instead of silently defaulting to zero.
Common protocol, train-input, and before/after loaded-source provenance checks.
Empty native ledger no longer produces a vacuous true gap claim.
Main artifact hashes include only the main audit products, so optional oracle/plot outputs do not create a circular re-audit dependency.

existing_synthetic_evidence.interpretation: Synthetic schema and fault-injection evidence only; the 480 count here is not actual benchmark completion or recovery.
